pull_request.body:
PCA previously required exporting prepared preprocessing results into nested rows. Add fit, transform and fitTransform for PreparedNumericBatch and PreparedNumericMatrix so training and held-out projection retain ordered feature names, original row positions and matrix layout. A DocC guide demonstrates train-only standardization followed by PCA.

CPU paths share centered column-major input with the existing full and randomized solvers. PCA omits unused randomized left-vector back-projection; public RandomizedSVD still returns complete U. Fit state commits only after successful validation and computation. Prepared inputs reject missing/nonfinite values and enforce fitted feature names. The documented fitting boundary also rejects nonfinite legacy inputs and GPU Float overflow. Existing device routing, solver defaults and projection accumulation are preserved.

Validation:

- 656 affected native tests passed in Debug and 656 in Release, with no failures or skips, including prepared layouts, provenance, invalid input, failed refits and GPU behavior.
- Six standardized model-conformance runs and certificate audit passed with unchanged tolerances.
- 90 fresh-process complete-workflow runs across wine, tall and wide data, both CPU solvers, and legacy/batch/both matrix layouts passed 540 field comparisons. Exported numerical results matched the fresh unchanged baseline exactly; full SVD also matched NumPy at 1e-12 absolute/relative tolerance.
- SwiftCluster DocC conversion passed without warnings.

Resource observations are limited to three repetitions on one Mac. Prepared batches used less peak RSS on the tall and wide cases; timings were mixed. No general speed claim or process memory bound is made. [Design and qualification records](https://github.com/crabel99/SwiftSci/blob/fea529e08cffc46318742f8b54a0545e45f7e9b8/Documentation/EngineeringNotes/benchmarks/2026-10-26-prepared-pca/README.md) are committed separately on the fork's engineering-notes branch.

maintainer_review.body:
The prepared PCA integration looks well structured, particularly the preservation of feature names, row provenance, and fitted-state consistency.

Before merging, please add checked dimension conversions and overflow-safe workspace sizing in PCAComputation.fullSVD. Also consider a regression test for finite inputs whose intermediate mean accumulation overflows.

Once these are addressed and CI is green, this should be ready for another review.
